text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder makes a valiant<n>attempt, but victory
slips through her<n>grasp.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her spirits are further dampened by<n>the thought
that this result would<n>have been the same even if
Maruzensky had been in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is disappointed in Grass<n>Wonder, noting
that she wasn't fully<n>focused on the race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Only then does Grass Wonder realize<n>she hasn't
truly clashed with her<n>contemporaries.
